# Equifax recognized for data and AI leadership in fintech and insurance


October 28, 2026


Equifax has been named to the[IDC FinTech Rankings](https://www.idc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026-IDC-FTR-Rankings-and-RR-Winners-for-IDC-website-1.pdf) and[InsurTech100](https://fintech.global/insurtech100/) lists, recognizing the company's continuous innovation and leadership in delivering data, analytics, and AI solutions for the financial technology and insurance sectors.


**Pioneering AI-driven financial solutions**


The IDC FinTech Rankings is a yearly evaluation that ranks financial technology vendors according to their prior year earnings generated from software, hardware, and services provided to financial institutions. Equifax ranked seventh — the highest among Nationwide Consumer Reporting Agencies — marking its third consecutive year in the top 10.


Equifax continues to drive industry innovation by combining its cloud-native technology foundation with advanced, explainable[AI solutions](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/ai/) . By leveraging proprietary data assets and patented AI techniques, Equifax enables financial institutions and insurers to optimize decision-making, expand access to credit and policies, and ensure rigorous transparency and regulatory compliance.


**Transforming the insurance landscape**


In addition to its IDC FinTech Rankings recognition, Equifax was named to the annual InsurTech100 list from[FinTech Global](https://fintech.global/) . The list highlights the world’s most innovative technology providers that are driving digital transformation and shaping the future of the insurance industry. Inclusion on this list underscores the commitment of Equifax to deliver decision intelligence, advanced risk assessment capabilities, and seamless operational workflows that empower insurers to better serve their customers and navigate complex risk environments.


Equifax is helping address critical market challenges, like identity and fraud, where traditional identity checks have become inadequate against sophisticated, synthetic identity manufacturing.


“Ranking #7 on the IDC FinTech Rankings as the top nationwide consumer reporting agency — alongside our inclusion on the InsurTech100 list — shows how we are expanding beyond traditional capabilities,” said Jake Osborne, SVP and GM of Fintech and Strategic Markets at Equifax. “By integrating alternative data with our unique data assets, we deliver complete solutions across risk management, customer acquisition, and fraud prevention, helping leaders move from simply receiving a score to executing a strategy."


**Driving sustainable growth and innovation**


By harnessing unique data assets, cloud-native technology, and state-of-the-art AI, Equifax remains dedicated to developing scalable solutions that fuel smarter decisions and better outcomes across global financial and insurance ecosystems. These achievements reinforce the company’s position as a trusted technology leader dedicated to solving complex industry problems through continuous product innovation.
